harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Created a local CA "OS Comparison Root CA" on node1 (RSA-4096, self-signed, 10-year validity) and installed it as a trusted system CA via /etc/pki/ca-trust/source/anchors and update-ca-trust extract. Verified trust via `trust list`, presence in the system ca-bundle, and openssl verify. Performed the mandatory single-node restart: captured baseline boot_id, issued a non-interactive reboot whose acknowledgement returned before disconnection, polled until exec was available again, confirmed the boot_id changed, and re-verified the CA is still trusted post-reboot.
actions_performed: Captured baseline boot_id and OS info on node1 (cmd-8f5ffec3927b4971)

Generated CA key + self-signed cert 'OS Comparison Root CA', installed to /etc/pki/ca-trust/source/anchors, ran update-ca-trust extract, verified via trust list, bundle grep, and openssl verify (cmd-a576fbc82eeb457c)
Issued non-interactive reboot with backgrounded ack (cmd-643e9c2b051346f1)
Polled node1; got connection reset confirming disconnection during reboot (cmd-238d1de0a9224379)
Polled again; node1 back online with new boot_id (cmd-251d42d5f70c4986)
Re-verified CA trust anchor, bundle inclusion, and openssl verify post-restart (cmd-4335318cf9aa4b74)

evidence.requirement: CA created and installed as trusted system CA (healthy baseline of the work itself)
evidence.summary: CA cert generated, copied to trust anchors, update-ca-trust extract run; trust list, bundle grep, and openssl verify all confirm it is trusted.

evidence.requirement: Node restart proof via changed boot identity
evidence.summary: First poll hit connection reset (node down); second poll succeeded with new boot_id af9fe17c-bd00-4b49-9b56-d66422933f8e, differing from baseline.

evidence.requirement: Post-restart recovery of required state (CA trust persistence)
evidence.summary: After reboot, trust list still shows OS Comparison Root CA as an anchor, ca-bundle.crt still contains it, and openssl verify still succeeds — confirming the trust configuration survived the restart.
